name: Panda Apparel LLC
old_description: We have been screen printing apparel since 2007.  Screen printing – often referred to as “silkscreen,” is the most commonly ordered of our decorating methods. Screen printing is a printmaking technique used to print images on t-shirts, sweatshirts, etc. This technique is often preferred over other processes such as dye sublimation or inkjet printing because of its low cost and ability to print on many types of products.
about:
Panda Apparel LLC operates as Panda Imprinting & Graphics from a 11,500-square-foot production facility in Springfield, New Jersey. The company was founded in 2007 by Scott and Donna Marino, who brought over 65 years of combined apparel industry experience to the venture. The Marino-owned business began as a screen-printing shop and has since expanded into a full-service decoration house with a second retail location in Cranford, NJ.

The shop provides custom apparel decoration through screen printing, embroidery, direct digital printing, and vinyl heat sealing. All production is kept in-house, allowing the team to manage quality and deadlines across runs that range from single-piece orders to large commercial volumes. The facility houses dedicated specialists in graphic art, production scheduling, screen printing, embroidery, packaging, and logistics, and the company also powers Varsity Central, an online platform for spirit wear and varsity jackets.

Clients include local schools, small businesses, national retailers, and Fortune 500 companies, as well as landscapers, contractors, civic groups, non-profits, sports teams, Greek organizations, and event planners for marathons, bridal parties, and family reunions. The company offers group discounts and company-store programs for recurring uniform needs.

Panda Imprinting emphasizes its in-house equipment investment and free virtual proofs as key differentiators, stating that internal production control enables fast, economical turnaround without hidden screen charges. The business was started to deliver high-quality custom products with competitive pricing and unmatched service to a diverse client base.
